analysis.title: Moelis & Co. (MC): 3Q26: Modest beat on non-comp discipline, combined with a strong restructuring outlook
key_insights: MC reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.75 vs GSe $0.73 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.72. The beat came from non-comp expenses 7% below the Street and about $2.2mn stronger non-operating income.
3Q26 adjusted revenue of $426mn was 1% below GSe and 2% below the Street, and up 13% YoY. Growth came from M&A and restructuring, partly offset by weaker capital markets.
YTD revenue mix is about 70% M&A and 30% non-M&A, vs two-thirds M&A and one-third non-M&A through 1H26.

Management is cautiously optimistic on M&A despite geopolitical uncertainty and market volatility. New business origination and the announced pipeline are both up about 20% YoY, and management cited a record pipeline.

Restructuring delivered near-record revenue. Management expects the approaching maturity wall, higher rates and AI-driven software disruption to support restructuring, and expects elevated liability management to turn into more traditional restructuring mandates over time.
The private capital advisory (PCA) platform is scaling, with deal pipelines building rapidly and expanded coverage planned across GP-led and LP-led secondaries.
Capital markets revenue was softer in the quarter. Management expects recovery on strong pipelines and client demand, including financing needs from elevated capex.
3Q26 adjusted operating margin was 19.8%, about 40bps above consensus. The non-comp ratio was about 80bps below consensus, partly offset by a comp ratio 40bps above.
The 3Q26 comp ratio was 65.8%, 40bps above the Street and down 40bps YoY. Non-comp expenses were 9% below GSe and 7% below the Street, and down 8% QoQ.

Management reiterated 2026E non-comp expense growth of about 19% YoY, implying a 14% QoQ step up in 4Q. Tech expense is expected to keep growing through 4Q26, with more AI spend pressure as costs move to token-based pricing.
GS cuts 2027E/28E revenue by 2% on the revenue mix shift toward restructuring from M&A and capital markets. 2026E/27E/28E EPS falls 1%/7%/7%.
GS keeps a Neutral rating and a $62 12-month price target. It rolls the Q5-Q8 P/E multiple forward one quarter (new window 4Q27E-3Q28E) and raises it to 15.5x from 14.5x on higher market multiples.
MC held its quarterly dividend at 65¢, repurchased 0.3mn shares in 3Q26, and has no funded debt.
GS expects a largely in-line stock reaction to results.

market_movers.rationale: Price target unchanged at $62 (6.2% upside from $58.38). EPS estimates were cut for 2026E-2028E, offset by a higher target multiple of 15.5x from 14.5x.

sector_views.rationale: Management sees a record M&A pipeline and near-record restructuring revenue. GS flags a near-term non-comp step up and a revenue mix shift away from M&A and capital markets.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported at $0.75 vs GSe $0.73 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.72. Reported 11/5.
3Q26 adjusted revenue reported at $426mn, 1% below GSe and 2% below the Street, up 13% YoY.
3Q26 adjusted operating margin reported at 19.8%, about 40bps above consensus. The comp ratio was 65.8%.
GS estimates (not reported): 2026E EPS $3.09 (old $3.11), 2027E $3.77 (old $4.04), 2028E $4.16 (old $4.48). Revenue estimates are 2026E $1,729.3mn, 2027E $2,012.8mn and 2028E $2,208.1mn.
Management guided FY26 non-comp expenses up about 19% YoY, implying a 14% QoQ increase in 4Q26. GS quarterly EPS estimates: 4Q26E $1.21, 1Q27E $0.73, 2Q27E $0.79.
risk_factors: Upside: better-than-expected M&A announcements, especially from sponsors, could drive higher margin and much larger capital return.
Downside: margin pressure from low completions and greater normalization of sponsor M&A.
Non-comp spend step up in 4Q26 and rising tech and AI costs.
geopolitical: Management referenced geopolitical uncertainty and market volatility as a backdrop to M&A activity. The report names no specific event or region.

tension_points.bear_case: 3Q26 revenue came in 1% below GSe and 2% below the Street, capital markets were soft, and non-comp expenses are guided to a 14% QoQ step up in 4Q. GS cuts 2027E/28E EPS by 7% and keeps a Neutral rating.
